approvals.layoutStatus: Draft layout plan dated 05-02-2026. The sanction authority block on the drawing is blank, so the layout was not yet sanctioned when the plan was issued. Confirm the sanctioned plan and K-RERA registration before paying any advance.
approvals.notes: A 66 kV HT line crosses the southern edge of the layout. Plot 87/1 carries 12 guntas of kharab land.
